narrative: The tables open on a bench at the Bear, one leaf of short lines from the fortnight at home, a candle, the bridle on a nail. No face. The stylus stays in the gutter. The leaf again. No new line under the three. The candle has not been moved to a writing height.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the old notes, judged them worse, and added nothing.

entities.name: the writing-tables
entities.context: Shown on tables in Less good than in the yard
